mutations.name: the line cap counts files code-graph never indexes
kills: locScope skips files code-graph never indexes: declarations, JS and excluded directories

mutations.name: the line cap ignores the rule's exclude patterns
kills: locScope matches excludes with code-graph's pattern semantics, globs included

mutations.name: a signal kill reads as an exit status
kills: planCommands names the signal that killed a step, which has a null exit status

mutations.name: a failing run ends without the summary line
kills: planCommands exits 1 with the summary when any step failed and 0 with none otherwise

mutations.name: a seeded run past the file budget keeps its cold fallback
kills: dead:check cold fallback forbids a cold fallback on a seeded run past the file budget
